clauses.text: A parent of a child eligible to attend public school may open an education savings account. The state shall deposit into the account 90 percent of the state per-pupil funding the child's resident district would otherwise receive.
Account funds may be used for private school tuition, tutoring, textbooks, and approved online courses.

current_law: State education funds are paid only to public school districts and charter schools.
